data.revised_prompt: Strict 16:9 horizontal image. Create a young Chinese Guochao campaign for an opera styling experience pavilion, based on the references. Keep traditional xiqu headwear shapes: black forehead hair patches, pearl tassels, blue-white-pink bead flowers, red pom-poms, curved lingzi arcs, water-sleeve gestures and precise opera makeup. Modernize the clothing for ages 16-35 without mamian skirts and without stereotypical new-Chinese long robes. Three models: left red martial dan wears cinnabar cropped embroidered jacket, blue mini cloud collar, gold tassel sash, ivory wide-leg pants; center wears jade-white and lake-blue short brocade top, pearl cloud-shoulder, soft straight trousers; right wears soft pink cropped jacket, floral embroidery, gauze sleeve panels, pleated skirt-shorts or culotte shorts. Bright fresh Chinese national-trend fashion, premium and wearable. East Suburb Memory red-brick courtyard/studio, warm daylight, greenery, refined commercial photography. No gothic, no cyberpunk, no black leather, no techwear, no Japanese elements, no text, no watermark.
